title: Split the root-probe harness tests out of scripts/root-probe-harness.mjs by concern
outcome: Split the root-probe harness tests out of scripts/root-probe-harness.mjs by concern
acceptance: The harness tests move into scripts/root-probe/tests/ (journal, acl, cleanup, integration, and a support module for the fake dependencies), with the real harness implementation and registerRootProbeTests plus the existing exports unchanged
Both existing registrars (parity and the optional root-probe registrar) discover the same tests exactly once, preserving deadlines, ACL restoration and restore/close/delete ordering

completion.summary: Split the root-probe harness tests into concern-based modules while preserving both registrars and cleanup ordering. Windows B's corrected build-then-Node run passed 37/37; the exact aggregate full gate passed and is landed on master, pushed, and installed.
